## Statistical model

We fit a linear mixed-effects model of the form:

$$
y_{ij} = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_{ij} + u_i + \varepsilon_{ij}
$$

where $u_i \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2_u)$ and $\varepsilon_{ij} \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$.

## Sample code

```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 100)
y = np.sin(x)

plt.plot(x, y)
plt.title("Sample sine wave")
plt.xlabel("x")
plt.ylabel("sin(x)")
plt.show()
```
